title: Pro-Cap: Leveraging a Frozen Vision-Language Model for Hateful Meme Detection
reasoning: The paper explicitly incorporates religion as one of the five primary categories for detecting hateful content. It develops specific 'probing questions' to identify the religion of individuals in memes (e.g., 'What is the religion of the person in the image?') and benchmarks the model's ability to detect hate speech targeted at religious groups.
